notes.title: Cricket 19 - July Update
notes.content:
[list][*] Added licensed West Indies men's and women's teams.
[*] Added licensed Russia and St Petersburg teams.
[*] Added achievements for West Indies.
[*] Added Test The Best Online Challenges mode.
[*] Added in-match Emote system.
[*] Added functionality to restore missing PlayFace data.
[*] Added Replay Camera invert options.
[*] Added Reset To Default option in Settings.
[*] Added option to turn off bowling input assistance on lower difficulty levels.
[*] Added Exit to Desktop option when quitting matches.
[*] Tuned AI runouts.
[*] Improved Batting Mid camera reaction after leaving ball.
[*] Ensured that 12th Man's Matches Played statistic does not increment.
[*] Ensured career player can return to club cricket if dropped from Domestic Team.
[*] Ensured correct stadium visuals will display on resume match screen.
[*] Resolved cases of missing sound effects during gameplay and menus.
[*] Resolved issue with custom stadiums not loading correctly in some modes.
[*] Resolved issue with custom uniform logos when resuming matches.
[*] Resolved issue with custom stadium sponsors in Scenario Mode.
[*] General Stability Improved.[/list]

notes.title: New Update Available - October 2020
notes.content:
A new update is now available for Cricket 19, featuring a number of improvements and requests from our community. 

Thanks for playing!


Patch Notes

Increased ability to execute advance shots against spinners
Added accessibility options to adjust field radar player colours
Added Trophy unlock for Bring the Paine in Career Mode
Added option for automatic appeals in difficulty settings
Added wicketkeeper edge appeal based on auto appeal setting
Balanced ratio of left and right handed bowlers within Career Mode
Balanced leg side shots
Balanced aggressive leg side shot effectiveness
Resolved incorrect count of overthrow runs when batsmen have crossed
Resolved Strength and Weakness being same Skill
Resolved zero fielding rating given to Deep Forward Mid-Wicket Position
Resolved matches incorrectly called Drawn where a team has an Injured player
Resolved Bowling leg side to Left handed batters
Resolved ground end names not being correctly identified
Resolved Gotham Filter anomalies
Various Stability Improvements

notes.title: Cricket 19 Update Available
notes.content:
Hi Cricket Fans,

We've just published a small update for Cricket 19, which addresses a spin bowling issue that some players had reported - thanks for letting us know and your patience, and you'll all be able to get those fearsome tweaks down the pitch again now!

Enjoy!
